pcs.pc_description: adhere by the time constraints set by the operator
ensure the crane body components is free of cracks and bearing wear
ensures that all labels are visible and in position according to the operating manual
check any hydraulic oil leaks and ensure that the oil level is adequate according to the manufacturer's indication
examine the battery for leaks and ensure that the fluid level is adequate according to the manufacturer's indicator
check the tyre pressure and lug nut torque according to the manufacturer's recommendations
check for engine oil leaks and fluid levels as indicated by the manufacturer's indication
add fuel and oil if needed as per manufacturer's indicator
check the holding and control breaks to ensure that they are functioning properly

check the following components for damage, improperly installed or missing parts as per the manufacturer s manual: Electrical components, wiring and electrical cables Hydraulic power unit, reservoir, hoses, fittings, cylinders and manifolds Platform, tower, turntable, scissor stack structures, their components and wear pads Tires and wheels Trailer lights and reflectors o Parking brake and electric braking system (including the breakaway system) Drive wheel and motor

check the following components as per operation manual: Outriggers and Wheels Limit switches Pins, nuts, bolts and other fasteners Hitch components Safety chains Engines their fuel systems and related components Axle components Personal protective devices
check that all structural and other key components are present and in working order, as specified in the operating handbook
check that all associated fasteners and pins are in position and properly fastened in accordance with the operating handbook
check that all compartment lids are in place and locked in accordance with the operating manual
visually inspect entire machine for: Cracks in welds or structural components Excessive rust, corrosion or oxidation Dents or damage to machine
keep a checking/maintenance logbook in which all actions conducted prior to operating the crane are recorded
if a defect is found that is outside the scope of his duty, notify the supervisor immediately

pcs.pc_description: plan and organise the work in accordance with the instructions
inspect the worksite to identify the soil condition to station the tyre mounted crane
make certain that the tyre-mounted crane is always assembled / stationed on solid, level ground
ensure tyre mounted crane is assembled near the load on smooth surface
position the hook in accordance with the operations handbook to attach the sling, shackle and chains
start the engine as per operations manual
ensure outriggers are extended fully as per manufacturer's manual
ensure outriggers are equipped with lock pins per manufacturer's manual
examine the assembly and confirm that all necessary safety precautions have been taken in accordance with the safety guidelines
in case of a crisis use emergency stop button to disable all power to the tyre mounted crane, as per operator manual

modules.module_title: Loading and hauling of the load

pcs.pc_description: ensure safe working load as per operation manual
check that the wind speeds are within the crane's operational limitations
ensure proper boom extension in accordance with the operation manual
before the actual lifting, hoist and release the weight at a low height to ensure that the holding and control breaks are working properly
carry out lifting of load in coordination with rigger as per the requirement
monitor stability whilst moving a load
maintain constant visibility of both ends of the crane arm
ensure that there are no barriers, people, or other impediments throughout the lifting procedure
look out for people working and hazards such as trenches, potholes and cables
abide by the time limitations imposed by the supervisors
perform in-service visual inspections on essential temperature and pressure gauges in accordance with the operation manual
in accordance with the operating handbook, choose and apply the appropriate kind of brake in various scenarios and conditions
ensure that walkway rules are observed, such as operating the crane within permissible/allocated zones
use the crane's numerous signaling systems with caution
maintain a safe distance from other plants and vehicles
work safely in accordance with operational requirements and associated safe systems of work
follow the instructions by the rigger
operate and control the boom as per operation manual
ensure that the laydown area is large enough to support the load
ensure the laydown space is free of any obstructions
make certain that no other operators travel on or near the tyre-mounted crane
report any issues encountered when using the tyre-mounted crane to the supervisor/rigger
when the equipment is left unattended, make sure it is properly shut down and secured
appropriately uninstall outriggers

pcs.pc_description: by monitoring the machine working hours plan the correct service schedule
check crane structure and the following accessories as per operation& maintenance manual

check crane structure for deformed, cracked or corroded members in the structure and boom loose bolts or rivets excessive wear on brake and clutch system parts, deformed wedges, defective cotter keys, pins and guard rails

check for the following in hydraulic system of crane as per operation & maintenance manual: deterioration or leakage in air or hydraulic systems safe and effective operation on hoses, pumps and motors levels of fluid air cleaners for replacement or cleaning

check for the following control mechanisms and monitoring devices as per operation & maintenance manual cables, brakes and levers for poor adjustment or excessive wear marking on the load/radius indicator over full range load moment indicator, boom angle indicator, boom length indicator and anti two-block system
check wire ropes for wear and tear
check the following in the main boom as per operation manual: lift cylinder(s) telescoping cylinder(s) hydraulic hoses / tubing & fittings holding device auxiliary boom head structure
check the following in the lattice boom extension boom extension alignment cords lattices end connections
refill coolants, lubricants and fluids in accordance with the operating and maintenance manual
grease all greasing pins and pivot points in accordance with the operation and maintenance handbook
check battery levels and terminal condition and make minor adjustments based on manufacturer's advice
check and maintain the tyre rims, air pressure, wheel nits and treads in accordance with the manufacturer's recommendations
before performing any repair, be certain that the machine is on firm and level ground
complete timely and legibly daily/ weekly maintenance sheets as provided by the company
ensure that suitable props/ support devices are used while performing maintenance
make certain that no engine repair is conducted while the engine is running or remains hot
assess when the problem is beyond his competence and report the problem to suitably qualified and competent personnel
diagnose the problem
at the work place, waste should be handled and disposed in accordance with environmental regulations
adhere to the reporting procedures established by the employer
complete all documents in accordance with the specified standards on time
in a timely way, report and escalate problems/incidents as needed
if a fault is found that is outside the scope of his duty, notify the supervisor immediately

pcs.pc_description: Comply with safety, health, security and environment related regulations/guidelines at the work site
use personal protective equipment (ppe) and other safety gear as applicable to the equipment and the worksite
Follow safety measures during operations to ensure that the health and safety of self or others (including members of the public) is not at risk
Carry out operations as per the manufacturer's and worksite related health and safety guidelines
Handle the transport, storage and disposal of hazardous materials and waste in compliance with worksite health, safety and environmental guidelines
operate various grades of fire extinguishers, as applicable
support in administering basic first aid and report to concerned team members, as required, in case of an accident
respond promptly and appropriately to an accident/ incident or emergency, within limits of your role and responsibility
record and report details related to operations, incidents or accidents, as applicable
